name: Dr. Mariano Javier de León Domínguez Romero

titles: Program Manager, Argentinian In-Kind Contribution to Vera C. Rubin Observatory (LSST)
bio_paragraphs: I am an observational cosmologist and astrostatistician based in Córdoba, Argentina, and La Serena, Chile. I serve as an Independent Researcher at CONICET (Instituto de Astronomía Teórica y Experimental, IATE), Associate Professor at the Observatorio Astronómico de Córdoba (OAC–UNC), and Professor at the Frontier Research Center (Centro de Investigaciones de Frontera), Universidad de La Serena.

My research bridges large-scale structure, photometric redshifts, Local Volume cosmology and dark matter subhalo wakes, Epoch of Reionization 21 cm cosmology, time-domain multi-messenger astronomy, and Scientific Machine Learning & Multimodal Foundation Models. Since 2021, I have served as Program Manager of the Argentinian In-Kind Contribution to the Vera C. Rubin Observatory (LSST), coordinating over 60 researchers across all eight Rubin Science Collaborations, and I also represent DESC on the Rubin SCOC Footprint Task Force.

At Universidad de La Serena, I represent ULS in TALASA and lead the development of the High-Performance Computing (HPC) & AI cluster for the Frontier Research Center (FRC). Alongside open-source astrophysical software development (Pontifex, Skykatana, νGundam, Corral, MeSsI) and leading Argentina's node in the Horizon Europe MEROPE consortium, I am deeply committed to interdisciplinary data science education—having co-founded the DiploDatos diploma at FaMAF–UNC, which has trained more than 500 data scientists.

news.text: Participating in next-generation spectroscopic surveys (WST & Spec-S5) and NASA's ASTRA COSMOSCOPE mission concept (site in development).
Representing Universidad de La Serena (ULS) in TALASA and leading development of the HPC & AI cluster for the Frontier Research Center (FRC) at ULS.
Pontifex (Mixture-of-Experts with Spatial Calibration for the Rubin–Roman Photometric Redshift Challenge) accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Atlanta, USA).
Horizon Europe MSCA Staff Exchanges grant MEROPE (€1,007,010; Project ID 101299854) launched with IATE–OAC–UNC as Argentinian Node Coordinator.
Appointed Professor at the Frontier Research Center (Centro de Investigaciones de Frontera), Universidad de La Serena, Chile.
Serving as DESC Representative on the Vera C. Rubin Observatory SCOC Footprint Task Force, aligning LSST Skykatana bright-star masking with the Roman Galactic Plane Survey.
Córdoba Provincial Legislature Commendation for the Argentinian Rubin Group, and Co-organizer & Keynote Speaker for the Rubin Observatory First Light celebration at OAC–UNC.
